falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4.0% above or below its close on the signal date, and that break holds for 3 consecutive daily closes within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained directional resolution would prove HOLD/UNKNOWN wrong: the tape was not unresolved, it was already in a committed trend.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 28 for 3 consecutive sessions, or US high-yield OAS widens by 75 bps or more versus the signal-date level, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed stress regime would invalidate both HOLD and the 77% bottom_2024_aug analog, which requires volatility crush and contained credit, not an active risk-off break.

falsification_conditions.condition: Nasdaq-100 gains at least 8% over any rolling 10 sessions inside the 14-day window while its daily RSI(14) closes above 75.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A parabolic equity impulse would falsify the moderate blowoff score of 38 and show the call missed an active blowoff rather than an unknown/hold state.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
